2607.18970.title: Skillware: A Software Ontology and Engineering Lifecycle for Persistent Behavioral Artifacts
2607.18970.paper_summary: Agent Skills have become persistent behavioral artifacts across independent AI agent systems. They combine natural-language task specifications with metadata and optional references, scripts, assets, hooks, package manifests, tests, and companion interfaces. Existing studies explain how Skills are specified, executed, maintained, and evolved, but lack an ontology that defines these artifacts as independent software objects. This paper introduces Skillware as the software abstraction that extends software engineering to persistent Behavioral Artifacts in agent systems. A Skill Artifact specifies reusable task behavior; a Skillware Unit manages that artifact as software through an independent identity and lifecycle. A compatible Agent Host activates the unit for runtime interpretation. Three necessary conditions operationalize category membership: behavioral primacy, independent software identity, and an Agent Host execution relationship. Lifecycle Continuity records whether the same unit identity persists through update, maintenance, rollback, and removal as a separate software-grade property. Evidence combines the Agent Skills specification, a frozen corpus of 138,133 content-deduplicated SKILL.md records associated with 20,556 repository identifiers, independent empirical studies, 15 category-boundary cases, and 13 fixed-revision engineering implementations. The evidence establishes a recurring artifact envelope, separable software identities, documented or reconstructed activation paths, and lifecycle engineering pressure. Skillware provides the software ontology and engineering lifecycle through which agent capabilities can become identifiable, composable, and maintainable software artifacts with an explicit basis for future evolution. Public design-pattern and evidence materials are available at https://github.com/MetaInFLow/skillware-patterns.
2607.18970.paper_summary_zh: 代理技能已成為獨立 AI 代理系統中持久的行為工件。<lb/>它們結合了自然語言任務規範、元數據和可選的參考、腳本、資產、鉤子、包清單、測試以及伴隨介面。<lb/>現有研究解釋了技能如何被指定、執行、維護和演變，但缺乏一個本體來定義這些工件為獨立的軟體物件。<lb/>本文介紹了 Skillware 作為一種軟體抽象，它將軟體工程擴展到代理系統中的持久行為工件。<lb/>一個技能工件指定可重用的任務行為；一個 Skillware 單元通過獨立的身份和生命週期將該工件作為軟體進行管理。<lb/>一個兼容的代理主機啟動該單元以進行運行時解釋。<lb/>三個必要條件使類別成員資格具體化：行為優先性、獨立的軟體身份，以及代理主機執行關係。<lb/>生命週期連續性記錄相同的單元身份是否在更新、維護、回滾和移除過程中持續存在，作為一個獨立的軟體級屬性。<lb/>證據結合了代理技能的規範、一個凍結的語料庫，包含 138,133 條內容去重的 SKILL.md 記錄，這些記錄與 20,556 個庫標識符相關聯，以及獨立的實證研究、15 個類別邊界案例和 13 個固定版本的工程實施。<lb/>這些證據建立了一個重複出現的工件封裝、可分離的軟體身份、記錄或重建的啟動路徑，以及生命週期工程壓力。<lb/>Skillware 提供了軟體本體和工程生命週期，通過這些，代理能力可以成為可識別、可組合和可維護的軟體工件，並為未來的演變提供明確的基礎。<lb/>公共設計模式和證據材料可在 https://github.com/MetaInFLow/skillware-patterns 獲得。
